description: Na₃LaTaSi₂PO₁₂ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-3.01 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.56 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.42 Å. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.22 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-42°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.75 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 23-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.72 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-48°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.62 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ta and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Ta and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ta, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom.
